prologue.line1: For as long as I remember, this village never stopped smoking. Chimney after chimney, day and night, the haze kept rising, like a heart that never stopped beating.
prologue.line2: Then one night the smoke stopped rising. It did not go out; it only stood still, hanging low over the rooftops as if waiting for something.
prologue.line3: Dimas came home because a debt was still owed to him. Raka came home because no one was waiting for him.
prologue.title: Asap yang Tak Padam
